 NexN2.5Pro on Hugging Face

NexN2.5Pro is the midtier model in NexAGI's newly announced NexN2.5 agentic model family, revealed around September 8, 2026. As of the latest check, its Hugging Face model card is live with full documentation and benchmarks, but the actual weight files are marked "coming soon" — they haven't been uploaded yet.[1][2]

 What it is

NexN2.5Pro is built on a 397Bparameter architecture (17B active parameters, mixtureofexperts) posttrained from a Qwen3.5 base, continuing the multimodal foundation of the earlier NexN2 generation. It's designed for longhorizon agentic tasks — meaning it doesn't just answer questions but can plan, act, observe results, and selfcorrect across many steps. Key capabilities emphasized by NexAGI include:[2][1]

 Computer use and browser automation (clicking, navigating, filling forms, verifying outcomes visually)
 Autonomous code execution and testing
 Visually grounded agentic reasoning, where vision serves as feedback rather than just input

 Benchmark performance

NexN2.5Pro sits between NexN2.5mini and NexN2.5Max, and is compared against models like Claude Opus 5, GPT5.6 Sol, KimiK3, GLM5.3, DeepSeekV4Pro, and Qwen3.8Max:[1]

| Benchmark | NexN2.5Pro | Best competitor |
||||
| TerminalBench 2.1 | 82.7 | 89.1 (Claude Opus 5) |
| SWEBench Pro | 61.2 | 79.2 (Claude Opus 5) |
| OSWorldVerified | 82.2 | 86.1 (Qwen3.8Max) |
| OSWorld2 | 56.4 | 68.3 (Claude Opus 5) |
| OSWorldG (grounding) | 87.4 | 87.4 (best, tied) |
| BrowseComp | 89.7 | 92.6 (NexN2.5Max) |

It trails frontier closed models like Claude Opus 5 and GPT5.6 Sol on most heavy coding/agentic benchmarks but performs competitively on visual grounding tasks (OSWorldG).[1]

 Deployment and availability status

NexAGI has published full deployment instructions expecting singlenode 8×H100 GPU serving via a customized SGLang fork (nexagi/sglang:v0.5.18-nex-patch), with recommended sampling settings (temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, top_k 40) and configurable "thinking modes" (none/medium/high reasoning effort). However, independent reporting from September 8, 2026 confirms the model card is live but weights are not yet downloadable — unlike NexN2.5mini, which can run on a 2×H100 setup already.[2][1]

This mirrors the pattern from NexAGI's earlier NexN2Pro release (June 2026), a 397B Apache 2.0licensed model that gained attention for rivaling GPT5.5class performance on coding tasks. If you want, I can watch for when the actual NexN2.5Pro weight shards get uploaded to Hugging Face.[3]
